name: AK-47 and Glock 17 Shooting
description:
Two famous firearms in one guided session: the AK-47 rifle and the Glock 17 pistol.

A qualified instructor stays with your group for the whole 90 minutes and starts with safe handling, so complete beginners can shoot. Each of you fires 15 rounds of 7.62×39 from the AK-47 and 10 rounds from the Glock 17, with all equipment and safety gear provided.

Keep score and the best shot wins the bragging rights. Book it for the daytime: bring a passport and come sober, as ranges will not let anyone shoot after drinking.
includes: Qualified instructor for the whole session; Safe-handling lesson before the first shot; 15 rounds AK-47 (7.62×39) each; 10 rounds Glock 17 each; Equipment and safety gear; Duration: 1 h 30 min

name: Army Tank Experience
description:
Ride across rough ground in a real Soviet-era BMP-1 armoured vehicle.

Private transport takes the group out of Prague and back. On site you get a 20-minute ride over mud and hills with expert guidance, a walk around the military museum and a soft drink each. No experience needed.

Loud, heavy and very photogenic, it works well as the centrepiece of a daytime plan.
includes: Private transport (roundtrip); 20-minute BMP-1 ride; Expert guidance on site; Military museum visit; Soft drink each; Duration: 1 hour

name: Axe Throwing
description:
Three hours of throwing: axes, knives and shuriken.

A qualified instructor opens with a five-minute safety briefing, then the group spends an hour on each weapon across two targets. Beginners pick it up quickly. Private transport there and back is included, with a beer or soft drink each.

Keep one scoreboard across all three weapons and crown an overall winner before dinner.
includes: Private transport (roundtrip); 5-minute safety briefing and qualified instructor; 1 hour of axe throwing; 1 hour of knife throwing; 1 hour of shuriken throwing; 2 targets for the group; 1 beer or soft drink each; Duration: 3 hours

name: Beer Olympics
description:
A two-hour private tournament of drinking games, with unlimited beer the whole time.

Split into teams for giant beer pong, classic beer pong, blow football and a basket-connect challenge. An instructor runs the games and keeps score, and beer, soft drinks and water are unlimited for the full two hours. Private transport there and back is included.

Every skill level can compete, which makes it a good afternoon warm-up before a night out.
includes: Private transport (roundtrip); Qualified instructor running the games; Giant beer pong and classic beer pong; Blow football and basket-connect games; Unlimited beer, soft drinks and water for 2 hours; Duration: 2 hours

name: Beer Spa
description:
A Czech speciality: a private bath of warm beer, with cold beer to drink alongside.

The group gets a 30-minute private beer bath, then an hour in the relaxation zone. Unlimited Czech beer flows for 90 minutes with salty snacks, and towels, sheets and slippers are provided. A Trivlu guide goes with you.

The best mid-weekend reset after a big night. Bring swimwear if you prefer to wear it.
includes: Trivlu guide; 30-minute private beer bath; 60 minutes in the relaxation zone; Unlimited beer for 90 minutes; Salty snacks; Towels, sheets and slippers each; Duration: 3 hours
extras: [{"code":"30-minute-massage","name":"30-minute massage","description":"A 30-minute massage for each person in the group.","price":45,"pricing":"PER_PERSON","translations":{"de":{"name":"30-Minuten-Massage","description":"Eine 30-minütige Massage für jede Person der Gruppe."}}}]

name: Beer Tasting Experience
description:
Five Czech draught beers, a reserved table and a guide who explains what you are drinking.

Your Trivlu guide leads a two-hour tasting of five 0.2-litre draught pours, covering traditional styles and local favourites. Once the group has picked a winner, each of you gets two 0.5-litre glasses of your favourite.

No beer knowledge needed. It works best early in the evening, and you leave knowing what to order for the rest of the weekend.
includes: Trivlu guide; Table reservation; 5 × 0.2 L draught beers for tasting each; 2 × 0.5 L of your favourite beer each; Duration: 2 hours

name: Bowling and Beers
description:
Your own bowling lane in a modern city-centre venue, with three beers each.

The group gets private lane hire and all equipment for two hours. A Trivlu guide gets you there and settled, so the first game starts straight away.

Everyone has bowled, nobody is very good, and a scoreboard does the rest. Weatherproof, and it fits well between lunch and a night out.
includes: Trivlu guide; Private bowling lane for 2 hours; Bowling equipment; 3 beers each; Duration: 2 hours

name: Breakfast With Tiffany
description:
A full English breakfast, followed by a 15-minute private show for the group.

Each of you gets a full English: two sausages, two eggs, two rashers of bacon, two hash browns, black and white pudding, tomato, mushrooms, beans and toast, with orange juice. Then a professional performer gives a 15-minute show in a private room, with the stag as guest of honour.

An English-speaking Trivlu guide arranges the sitting and the timing. Over-18s only.
includes: English-speaking Trivlu guide; Full English breakfast each (2 sausages, 2 eggs, 2 bacon rashers, 2 hash browns, black and white pudding, tomato, mushrooms, beans, toast); Orange juice (0.2 L) each; 15-minute private show by a professional performer; Private room; 18+ only; Duration: 1 hour

name: Bubble Football
description:
Football played inside giant inflatable bubbles, where the hits are big and painless.

You get an hour of playing time with a qualified instructor and a referee, plus all equipment and safety gear. A Trivlu guide meets the group, and there is a beer for each player after the final whistle.

Fitness matters less than you would think, and the video is always worth keeping. A good daytime energy burner.
includes: Trivlu guide; Qualified instructor and referee; 1 hour of playing time; Bubbles and safety gear; Beer each after the match; Duration: 1 hour

name: Burger & Private Show
description:
Burgers and beers in a private room, then a 15-minute show for the group.

Each of you gets a cheeseburger with fries and sauce and two beers. Once the plates are cleared, a professional performer gives a 15-minute private show, with the stag as guest of honour.

One venue in central Prague, no taxis in between, all booked and timed by an English-speaking Trivlu guide. Over-18s only.
includes: English-speaking Trivlu guide; Private room in central Prague; Burger with fries and sauce each; 2 beers each; 15-minute private show by a professional performer; 18+ only; Duration: 1 h 40 min

name: Car Demolition in Prague
description:
A real car, the tools and permission to wreck it.

Under a qualified instructor and in full safety gear, the group takes turns demolishing an actual vehicle. Private transport there and back is included, there is water to cool down between rounds, and a Trivlu guide runs the day.

Loud, satisfying and very photogenic.
includes: Trivlu guide; Private transport (roundtrip); A real car to demolish; Qualified instructor; Equipment and safety gear; Water each; Duration: 1 hour

name: Card Games Evening
description:
A private underground room for six hours of poker, blackjack and other card games.

The room is reserved for your group only, with tables set up for cards, and each of you gets a 1,000 CZK bar voucher. A Trivlu guide gets everyone settled; after that you set the buy-ins, run a tournament or just deal until late.

A good choice for groups who want a night together rather than queues at bars.
includes: Trivlu guide; Private room for 6 hours; Tables set up for card games; 1,000 CZK bar voucher each; Duration: 6 hours

name: Car football
description:
Football played with cars: shove an oversized ball towards the goal.

The group gets an hour of car football, with a private transfer to the venue and a Trivlu guide keeping the day on schedule. No motorsport experience is needed, as control matters more than speed. There is a beer for each player after the final whistle.

Allow around two and a half hours door to door.
includes: Trivlu guide; Private transfer; 1 hour of car football; Beer each after the game; Duration: 2 h 20 min

name: Casino Night
description:
A Prague casino evening with a local guide, and free club entry when the chips run out.

Casino entry is arranged for the group: poker, blackjack, roulette and slots. Your Trivlu guide brings local tips and free entry to selected Prague clubs, so the night moves on rather than winding down.

Set a budget each before you start, and bring a passport: casinos check ID at the door.
includes: Trivlu guide; Casino entry; Free entry to selected Prague clubs afterwards; Local tips for the night; Duration: 3 hours

name: Clay Pigeon Shooting
description:
Shotguns, moving targets and a leaderboard, just outside Prague.

A qualified instructor covers stance and technique first, so beginners are welcome. Each of you shoots at 12 clay pigeons with 24 cartridges, with full equipment and safety gear. Private transport is included, a Trivlu guide manages the outing, and beer and soft drinks are served after the shooting.

Score it properly and give the worst shot a forfeit. Bring a passport and come sober.

name: Cocktails & Karaoke night
description:
A reserved table at a karaoke bar and a cocktail each to warm up the voices.

Your Trivlu guide gets the group there and settled; after that the playlist is yours, including the solo the stag will be made to sing.

No talent needed. It works as a warm-up before the clubs or as the main event of the night.

name: Czech dinner with national show
description:
A three-course Czech dinner with beer, a national shot and a live folk show.

Your table is reserved for a three-course traditional Czech menu with three beers and one national shot each, while a live show with music and entertainment plays around you. A Trivlu guide gets the group seated.

Hearty food, a lively room and some local culture: a good anchor meal for the weekend.
includes: Trivlu guide; Table reservation; 3-course traditional Czech menu; 3 beers and 1 national shot each; Live national music and show; Duration: 1 h 30 min

name: Czech Lunch or Dinner
description:
A traditional Czech meal with two beers, finished by a 15-minute private show.

Each of you gets a national Czech dish and two beers. As the plates are cleared, a professional performer gives a 15-minute show for the group in a private room, with the stag as guest of honour. An English-speaking Trivlu guide arranges the table and the timing.

Authentic food first, entertainment second, all in 90 minutes. Over-18s only.
includes: English-speaking Trivlu guide; National Czech dish each; 2 beers each; 15-minute private show by a professional performer; Private room for the show; 18+ only; Duration: 1 h 30 min

name: Dog chase
description:
A prank for the stag: he runs, a trained dog chases.

During an hour-long outing the groom finds out how fast he really is with a trained dog on his heels, while the rest of the group watches from a safe distance. A Trivlu guide runs it, and public transport to the venue is covered.

Some details are best kept from the groom; your Trivlu guide explains the setup when you book.
includes: Trivlu guide; Public transport to the venue; Chase with a trained dog; Group watches from a safe distance; Duration: 1 hour

name: Dungeon Of Horror Experience
description:
A horror escape game in the cellars beneath Prague.

Your team has 25 minutes to solve puzzles and find a way out of dark rooms and catacombs. A qualified instructor gives a safety briefing and oversees the game, and the package adds a haunted house tour, two drinks each, and photos and videos of the group. A Trivlu guide handles the logistics.

Short, and funny in hindsight: the footage settles who screamed first.
includes: Trivlu guide; Safety briefing and qualified instructor; 25-minute horror escape game; Haunted house tour; 2 drinks each; Photos and videos of the group; Duration: about 40 minutes

name: Dwarf Hire
description:
A professional entertainer joins your night out for an hour.

How the hour goes is up to the group: a surprise for the stag, a companion for a bar stop or a guest for the photos. The entertainer is a professional performer, so treat them as you would anyone you have hired.

It pairs naturally with a bar or club stop on a Prague night out.
includes: Professional entertainer for 1 hour; Joins your group on your night out in Prague; Can be arranged as a surprise for the stag; Booked and timed in advance through Trivlu

name: Extreme Archery
description:
Paintball without the paint: two teams, bows and a full hour of play.

The game runs in an indoor arena in central Prague that was a film location for the Hollywood film 'Wanted'. All equipment and safety gear are provided, the stag gets a costume, and each player gets a beer or soft drink. A Trivlu guide runs the session.

It suits every fitness level and turns competitive within minutes.
includes: Trivlu guide; 1 hour of playing time; Bows, arrows and safety gear; Costume for the stag; Beer or soft drink each; Duration: 1 h 30 min

name: Foot Darts
description:
Darts played with footballs: kick the ball at a giant dartboard.

The group gets 60 minutes of play with a qualified instructor keeping score, equipment provided and private transport there and back. There is a beer or water for each player, and a prank scenario can be set up if the stag deserves one.

Football skill only half-translates, which is the fun of it. Play singles, doubles or a full tournament.
includes: Trivlu guide; Private transport (roundtrip); Qualified instructor; 60 minutes of play on a giant board; Equipment; Beer or water each; Duration: 2 h 30 min

name: Footgolf
description:
Golf played with a football, on a proper course just outside Prague.

The group plays a 90-minute round, kicking towards oversized holes. Private transport there and back is included and a Trivlu guide keeps the day on schedule. The course is open from April to October.

No equipment to master and no etiquette to learn: keep score and play for a forfeit.
includes: Trivlu guide; Private transport (roundtrip); 90-minute footgolf round; Season: April to October; Duration: 2 hours

name: Ford Boyard Challenge
description:
A team mission of puzzles and physical trials, inspired by the TV adventure format.

Over 90 minutes of play the group works through challenges that need both brains and nerve, and someone always has to volunteer for the unpleasant one. The stag gets his own T-shirt, and everyone gets a beer or soft drink at the end. A Trivlu guide runs the day.

It rewards teamwork, and the quiet one often turns out to be the hero.
includes: Trivlu guide; 90 minutes of play; Physical and mental challenges; T-shirt for the stag; Beer or soft drink each; Duration: about 2 hours

name: Full Irish Breakfast
description:
A reserved table and a full Irish breakfast to repair last night.

Each of you gets two sausages, two eggs, two rashers of bacon and two hash browns, plus black and white pudding, tomato, mushrooms, beans and toast, and two drinks each: beer, juice or soft drinks. A Trivlu guide books the table.

An hour of serious fuel that resets the group for the day ahead.
includes: Trivlu guide; Table reservation; Full Irish breakfast each (2 sausages, 2 eggs, 2 bacon rashers, 2 hash browns, black and white pudding, tomato, mushrooms, beans, toast); 2 drinks each (beer, juice or soft drink); Duration: 1 hour

name: Gentlemen's Club Night + Bar Tab
description:
A guided night out that ends at a VIP table in one of Prague's gentlemen's clubs.

An English-speaking Trivlu guide takes the group through the city's nightlife, then into the club, where entry is covered, a VIP table is reserved and each of you has a drinks voucher. No queues and no haggling at the door.

Allow about three and a half hours. Over-18s only; the club's house rules apply, including no touching the performers.
includes: English-speaking Trivlu guide; Guided start through Prague nightlife; Gentlemen's club entry; VIP table reservation; Drinks voucher each; 18+ only; Duration: about 3 h 30 min

name: Gin Tasting
description:
Four gins, a reserved table and someone who explains them.

Your group sits down in a private Irish pub for a tasting of four gins each, with insight into what you are drinking and why it tastes that way. A Trivlu guide arranges it, and food can be added if the group wants a base layer before going out.

Relaxed and sociable: a good start to the evening.
includes: Trivlu guide; Table reservation in an Irish pub; 4 gins for tasting each; Guided tasting notes; Duration: 1 hour

name: Go-Karting Experience
description:
Find out who really is the best driver, on a professional kart track.

Each of you gets two 10-minute rides: one to learn the track, one flat out for the fastest lap. Private transport there and back is included, a Trivlu guide keeps the day moving, and there is a beer each for the podium debate.

Lap times settle the argument. Quick, competitive and easy to fit into an afternoon.
includes: Trivlu guide; Private transport (roundtrip); 2 × 10-minute rides each; Lap times for every driver; Beer each after racing; Duration: 45 minutes

name: Grilled Suckling Pig
description:
A whole roasted suckling pig carried to your table in a historic brewery restaurant.

The restaurant brews its own Czech beer and has Gothic-style interiors. Your table is reserved, and the feast comes with side dishes and two large beers per person. A Trivlu guide books the group in.

Allow about two hours: carving a whole pig between friends is not a meal to rush.

name: Guided Cabaret Club Tour
description:
A guided bar route through Prague that ends at one of the city's top cabaret clubs.

A local Trivlu guide takes the group through a selection of bars, shares the tips that never reach the guidebooks and handles every door. The night finishes with entry to a cabaret club, and free entry to selected clubs is included along the way.

A good first-night format: you learn where the good rooms are and arrive at the last one together. Over-18s only.
includes: Trivlu guide; Guided route through a selection of bars; Local tips; Cabaret club entry; Free entry to selected Prague clubs; 18+ only; Duration: 2 hours

name: Hangover Brunch
description:
A 90-minute brunch with an hour of unlimited beer, wine and mimosas.

The table gets pancakes with Nutella and strawberries, avocado toast with poached egg and parmesan, waffles with berry compote and cream, French toast with crispy bacon and maple syrup, and fruit oats. For one hour, beer, wine and mimosas are unlimited. A Trivlu guide books it.

The group reassembles, last night gets its first retelling, and everyone is ready for the afternoon.

name: Hummer Limo
description:
An hour through Prague in a Hummer limousine, with bubbly on board.

A driver takes the group around the city with music and lights on, and bottles of bubbly are included. Use it as a rolling pre-party, a transfer between venues or a grand arrival at the club.

The transport is the event: the stag rides up front in every photo.
includes: Hummer limousine with driver; 1-hour ride or transfer; Bottles of bubbly; Music and lights on board; Duration: 1 hour

name: Jelly Wrestling
description:
A 10-minute duo show and 10 minutes of jelly wrestling, with the stag in the pool.

At a Prague club, two professional performers give a 10-minute show, then wrestle in a pool of jelly for 10 minutes, and the stag gets a round in the pool himself. Club entry, a drink and a beer each are included, and showers and towels are ready afterwards.

An English-speaking Trivlu guide arranges it. Over-18s only; the club's house rules apply.
includes: English-speaking Trivlu guide; Club entry; 10-minute duo show by two professional performers; 10 minutes of jelly wrestling, with a round for the stag; Drink and beer each; Shower and towels; 18+ only; Duration: 45 minutes

name: Lamborghini Ride
description:
Thirty minutes in a Lamborghini Gallardo LP560-4 with a professional driver.

The car runs on the highway with a professional at the wheel, so you get the acceleration and the sound without the speeding tickets. Private transport to the start point and back is included, photos and videos are part of the package, and a Trivlu guide manages the day.

Allow about 90 minutes in total.
includes: Trivlu guide; Private transport (roundtrip); 30-minute ride with a professional driver; Photos and videos; Duration: 1 h 30 min

name: Laser Tag
description:
Two 15-minute laser tag games in a 300 m² maze in Prague.

Play solo or in teams, with all equipment provided and a beer or soft drink each at the end. A Trivlu guide gets the group in and set up.

No bruises and no laundry, but just as competitive as paintball. The scoreboard settles every argument.

Ten people, one door policy: VIP entry keeps the group together all night. Dress smart.

name: VR Gaming
description:
Two hours of virtual reality games in central Prague.

The group gets two hours of play on VR setups with a private chill-out zone, plus two beers or soft drinks each. Watching the others flail at invisible enemies is half the fun. A Trivlu guide books it.

Weatherproof and hangover-friendly.
includes: Trivlu guide; 2 hours of play; VR setups for the group; Private chill-out zone; 2 beers or soft drinks each; Duration: 2 hours

name: Water gun battle
description:
An hour of team battles with water guns.

Simple tactics, constant soakings and no bruises. Private transport is included, a Trivlu guide organises the session, and there is a drink for each player when the ceasefire is called.

Best in warm weather; bring a change of clothes.
includes: Trivlu guide; Private transport; 1 hour of play; Water guns for everyone; Drink each; Duration: 1 h 30 min

name: Wellness & Spa
description:
A recovery afternoon of saunas, pools and quiet.

Each of you gets a three-hour spa pass covering the pools and saunas, with showers, changing rooms and lockers. Private transport there and back is included, and a Trivlu guide makes sure nobody has to navigate with a headache.

Book it for the day after the big night. Bring swimwear.
includes: Trivlu guide; Private transport (roundtrip); 3-hour spa pass; Pool and sauna entry; Showers, changing rooms and lockers

name: Whiskey Tasting
description:
Five whiskies from four countries in one hour, including a Czech one.

Your table is reserved at a cosy Prague bar for a guided tasting of five drams from Ireland, Scotland, the USA and Czechia, mixing tasting with stories. Beginners and seasoned drinkers both get something from it, and snacks can be added. A Trivlu guide arranges everything.

A good early-evening gear change.
includes: Trivlu guide; Table reservation; 5 whiskies for tasting each; From Ireland, Scotland, the USA and Czechia; Duration: 1 hour

name: Wine Tasting
description:
A wine tasting led by a French sommelier, with tapas and a two-course meal.

In an elegant Prague restaurant the sommelier presents European and South American wines: white, sparkling, rosé and red. It opens with tapas of cheese and sausages with bread, and each of you gets a two-course meal. Public transport is covered and a Trivlu guide coordinates the evening.

Three relaxed hours: the most refined chapter of the weekend.
includes: Trivlu guide; Public transport; Table reservation; Sommelier and wine presentation; White, sparkling, rosé and red wines; Tapas: cheese and sausages with bread; 2-course meal each; Duration: 3 hours

name: XXL Cabaret Comedy Show
description:
An hour of adult cabaret comedy, with unlimited beer and a 15-minute show.

A lively stage performance mixes comedy, dance and theatrical numbers, with an hour of unlimited beer and a 15-minute show by a professional performer for your group. An English-speaking Trivlu guide books it.

No concentration required: the bridge between dinner and the clubs. Over-18s only.
includes: English-speaking Trivlu guide; 1-hour cabaret comedy show; 15-minute show by a professional performer; 1 hour of unlimited beer; 18+ only; Duration: 1 hour

name: Guided Bar Crawl with Club Entry
description:
An evening bar crawl with a guide, welcome shots and club entry at the end.

Your Trivlu guide leads the group through four bars from around 19:00, sorting tables and doors so nobody gets lost. Welcome shots are included along the way, and the night ends with entry to a nightclub. Drinks beyond the shots are paid at the bar.

The classic first night out: by the last stop the group knows where it wants to go back to.
includes: Trivlu guide; 4 bars in one evening; Welcome shots along the way; Nightclub entry at the end; Starts around 19:00; Duration: 4 hours

name: Classic Beer Bike
description:
Pedal a beer bike through Prague while the beer keeps flowing.

The group sits around the bar of a multi-seat bike and pedals, while a driver steers and handles the traffic. Beer is served from the keg on board for the whole hour, with music to set the mood.

One of the most booked stag activities in Prague: easy, social and very visible.
includes: Beer bike for your group only; Driver who steers and handles traffic; Beer from the on-board keg for the ride; Music on board; Duration: 1 hour

name: Escape Room Challenge
description:
Sixty minutes, a locked room and a team that has to think its way out.

Split into teams of up to five and race the clock through puzzles, codes and hidden clues. A game master briefs you, watches the game and sends hints when you are stuck. No experience needed; sober heads help.

Book two rooms side by side and compare times.
includes: Private escape room for your team; Game master briefing and hints; 60 minutes to escape; Teams of up to 5 per room; Duration: 1 hour

name: Medieval Sword Fighting
description:
Learn to fight with medieval swords, then prove it in a duel.

An instructor teaches the basic guards, cuts and footwork with blunt training swords and protective gear, then the group pairs up for duels and a knockout tournament.

Physical without engines or guns, and the winner keeps the title for the weekend.
includes: Instructor; Lesson in basic technique; Blunt training swords; Protective gear; Duels and a knockout tournament; Duration: 1 h 30 min

name: Segway Tour
description:
See Prague's parks and viewpoints on a Segway, with a guide.

After a short training session, a guide leads the group on Segways along a route outside the historic-centre zones where Segways are not allowed, stopping at viewpoints with the stories behind them. You cover far more ground than on foot.

Daytime only; the guide sets the route and the pace.
includes: Segway for each rider; Helmet; Short training before you set off; English-speaking guide; Route with stops at viewpoints; Duration: 1 h 30 min

name: Brewery Tour and Tasting
description:
Walk through a working Czech brewery and taste the beer at the source.

A guide shows the group how the beer is made, from malt and hops to the fermentation and lagering tanks, then sits you down for a tasting of the house beers.

The best way to understand why Czech beer tastes the way it does, and a calm start to a big evening.
includes: English-speaking guide; Guided brewery tour; How Czech beer is brewed, from malt to lagering; Seated tasting of the house beers; Duration: 2 hours

name: Ice Bar Visit
description:
A bar built of ice and kept below freezing, with drinks served in ice glasses.

Thermal capes and gloves are handed out at the door, then the group has drinks among ice walls, ice furniture and ice glasses. Most groups stay 30 to 45 minutes before the cold wins.

A short, photogenic stop on the way to dinner or the clubs.
includes: Ice bar entry; Thermal cape and gloves; Welcome drink in an ice glass; Room kept below freezing; Duration: 45 minutes

name: Rage Room
description:
A room full of plates, bottles and old electronics, and a sledgehammer to deal with them.

After a safety briefing, each of you suits up in overalls, a helmet with visor and gloves, picks a tool and takes a turn smashing the room.

Short, loud and surprisingly good for a hangover.
includes: Safety briefing; Overalls, helmet with visor and gloves; Bats, hammers and crowbars; Items to smash for each person; Duration: 1 hour

name: Summer Bobsled
description:
Race down a summer bobsled track in the hills outside Prague.

Private transport takes the group out of the city to the track, where each of you gets several runs on a sled with your own brake. Time the runs and the fastest rider takes the title.

The track runs in dry weather and closes in rain.
includes: Private transport (roundtrip); Several runs each on the bobsled track; Sled with your own brake; Track staff on site; Duration: 3 hours

name: Football Match Tickets
description:
Watch a Czech league match with the home crowd.

Trivlu books match tickets for the group in the same section, and a guide takes you to the stadium and back on public transport. Beer at Czech grounds is cheap and the atmosphere is loud.

Fixtures follow the league calendar, so check the dates of your weekend before booking.
includes: Match ticket each; Seats together for the group; Trivlu guide to the stadium and back; Public transport tickets; Duration: 3 hours
